summary.text: 试 is the simplified counterpart of 試. The traditional graph is analyzed as combining 言 for a meaning category with 式 as a sound element; current meanings include “test” and “try.”

formation.text: The traditional graph 試 is analyzed as phonosemantic: 言 contributes a meaning category and 式 a sound cue. Both read shì in modern Mandarin. In the supplied Baxter–Sagart forms, 式 *l̥ək and 試 *l̥ək-s are similar but not identical; the difference does not establish a historical sound derivation or the proposed suffix analysis.

components.text: In 試, 言 is identified as the meaning element. This account applies to the traditional graph; 试 is paired with 試 as its simplified counterpart.
In 試, 式 is identified as the sound element. Both read shì in modern Mandarin; supplied Baxter–Sagart forms differ by an added -s in 試, which does not establish the historical derivation.

sound_limitation.text: The supplied Baxter–Sagart forms are similar but not identical: 式 *l̥ək and 試 *l̥ək-s, with -s in 試. This comparison does not establish a historical phonetic derivation or the proposed suffix analysis.

sound.text: 式 and 試 share the modern Mandarin reading shì.

history.text: The received Shuowen account analyzes 試 as 从言式聲, glosses it 用也 (“use”), and quotes 明試以功. That quotation is from a received text whose date and manuscript witness remain unresolved.
The earliest graphic form of 試 and any sequence of early written forms remain unresolved. A competing claim that the graph arose through corruption has not been verified.
The evidence pairs 试 with 試 as simplified and traditional forms, but does not establish the standardization process or prove that the visible 言-to-讠 change alone explains the pairing.

uncertainties.text: The earliest securely dated attestation of 試 and its word use remains unresolved.
The historical sound relation between 式 and 試, including a proposed exoactive or causative suffix analysis, remains unsettled.
Recorded uses include use or appointment, trying, testing, probing, and examination, but their chronology and pathways are not established.

senses.text: Current dictionary glosses for 试 and 試 include “test,” “try,” and “experiment.”
The received Shuowen account glosses 試 as 用也 (“use”); dictionaries also record uses meaning use or appointment.
Dictionaries record uses glossed as probe, examination, and testing, without establishing when they arose or how they relate to use or appointment.

limitations.text: The recorded glosses and examples do not establish the earliest attested meaning or a chronology connecting use, trying, testing, probing, and examination.

overview.text: 试 is the simplified counterpart of 試, whose traditional analysis gives 言 a meaning role and 式 a sound role. Common meanings include “test” and “try.”

components.text: In 試, 言 contributes a meaning category; this account belongs to the traditional graph.
式 supplies the sound cue in 試; both read shì in modern Mandarin, though their historical sound relation is unsettled.

relationships.text: In the received analysis of traditional 試, 言 is identified as its meaning element, while 式 supplies the sound.
In the received analysis of 試, 式 is its sound element. Both have modern Mandarin reading shì; reported historical comparisons do not settle the sound relation or its derivation.
The dictionary pairs 试 with 試 as its simplified and traditional forms. This character-level relationship connects the traditional host of the component analysis to the entry character.
